integrity.numerical_scope: finite independent edge-pair quadrature; not an infinite certificate

scientific_limitations: Uniform cubic-gap expansion requires all angular mesh gaps tend to zero, with maximum <= 1/4 in the explicit uniform claim.
The logarithmic second term is proved only for regular polygons; finite-size exact optimality among n-gons is not claimed.
Priority is provisional; some unindexed sources and inaccessible primary full texts remain unexamined.
title: Cubic angular-gap stability and a logarithmic correction for polygonal boundary-chord means
